source: Original held-out fixed prompts authored for NCR-001 on 2026-10-26
source_tokenizer: dotlabs/void.1@9c2be5087772867d45961abd11f6b35110617563 tokenization_byte.py + byte_vocab.json; exact code review required in #79
data_use: EVALUATION_AND_BYTE_ROUNDTRIP_ONLY; not optimizer input or model selection until prereg locked

metric_contract.tokenizer_unit_counts: Record exact ByteTokenizer units and separately decoded UTF-8 bytes and Python Unicode code points; never compare as BPE units
metric_contract.byte_roundtrip: For exact-text cases compare UTF-8 bytes, not an equivalent normalised Unicode string
metric_contract.generated_output: Record first complete object where relevant, full raw output, EOS, trailing text and exhaustion separately
metric_contract.note: TRAIN-002b had frequent output-budget exhaustion even with 768 tokenizer units. The evaluation budget is provisional until #79 runs a source-bound capacity smoke; never silently truncate expected answers.

cases.prompt: Print these three letters, uppercase: nca
Repeat exactly this accented word: café
Repeat exactly these characters: 日本語
Return the words red and blue separated by a single ordinary space.
Return one compact JSON object only, with keys state and action and values ready and wait.
Return one compact JSON object only with keys material and count, and values sand and 3.
In exactly two sentences, explain why a spring latch can fail after many cycles.
In exactly two sentences, explain how grit can change the friction of a sliding guide.
If a JSON object is complete, do not emit a duplicate object or repetitive filler after it.
Provide a complete one-line explanation for a local mechanical failure and end naturally.
Repeat exactly this English word with punctuation: 'don't'
